title: Finite normalization of the system projection-evaluation word
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every scheme $W$ use a small skeleton of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$, completed coefficient sheaf $R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$, and ordinary unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On the vertical sequence site write $\mathcal Q_W(n,U)=(A_n)_W(U)$, $R_W^{\mathrm{const}}$ for the constant sequence ring, $\mathscr P$ for the one-point sequence topos, and $\mathcal A=(A_n)_n$ for its quotient ring [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Let $\rho_W:(W^{\mathrm{Tow}},\mathcal Q_W)\to(W^{\mathrm{Tow}},R_W^{\mathrm{const}})$ and $\rho_0:(\mathscr P,\mathcal A)\to(\mathscr P,R)$ be scalar restriction morphisms. Write $g_W^{\mathcal Q}$ and $g_W^R$ for point-sections morphisms to these one-point sequence topoi, with $g_W^R\rho_W=\rho_0g_W^{\mathcal Q}$. The symbol $Rg_*$ means derived sections with values in towers, without inverse limit. Restriction $\rho_*$ is exact. Use the derived internal Hom and signed closed tensor-Hom structure [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model].
Let $k$ be a field with $\ell$ invertible, and let $a:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes, with a fixed compactification $X\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow pY$, $pj=a$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the quotient sequence sites put $F^{\mathcal Q}=Rp_*^{\mathcal Q}j_!$, with proper image derived after exact open extension, and $F_n=Rp_{*,n}j_!$ at $A_n$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For $K\in D(R_X)$ put $V=\operatorname{const}K$ and $M=L\rho_X^*V$, with $M_n=K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_n)_X$ and actual quotient transitions [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction].
Let $N\in D(\mathcal Q_X)$, $N_n=\operatorname{ev}_nN$, $D=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal Q_X}(M,N)$, $h=Rg_{X*}^{\mathcal Q}D$, $b_M=Rg_{Y*}^{\mathcal Q}F^{\mathcal Q}M$, and $b_N=Rg_{Y*}^{\mathcal Q}F^{\mathcal Q}N$. Specify $\widetilde\beta_{M,N}$ by the sequence-site word of [lem-coef-system-projection-evaluation]: scalar balancing, symmetry, the sections projection mate, the proper projection mate, open tensor comparison and closed evaluation after the $g_X$ counit. Use the Hom tower and its canonical comparison of [lem-coef-hom-tower-scalar-model], and the support comparisons of [lem-coef-support-open-tensor-model]. Let $B_K=\rho_{0*}b_M$ and $B_N=\rho_{0*}b_N$, and let $\beta_{K,N}:\mathsf H_N(K)\otimes_R^LB_K\to B_N$ be its transport by the full-system scalar-Hom comparison. Then, under the canonical exact evaluation/tensor isomorphism and the comparisons
$$\operatorname{ev}_n\mathsf H_N(K)\cong R\operatorname{Hom}_{X,A_n}(K_n,N_n),\quad\operatorname{ev}_nB_K\cong R\Gamma(Y,F_nK_n),\quad\operatorname{ev}_nB_N\cong R\Gamma(Y,F_nN_n),$$
the map $\operatorname{ev}_n\beta_{K,N}$ is exactly
$$R\operatorname{Hom}_{X,A_n}(K_n,N_n)\otimes_R^LR\Gamma(Y,F_nK_n)\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_{X,A_n}(K_n,N_n)\otimes_{A_n}^LR\Gamma(Y,F_nK_n)\longrightarrow R\Gamma(Y,F_nN_n).$$
The first arrow is scalar balancing. In the second, the finite sections mate is followed by the ambient compact-support projection of [def-exchange-projection] with the actual open tensor comparison, and then finite evaluation after the sections counit. More precisely the evaluated adjoint defining $\pi_p$ is $(\varepsilon_{p,j_!K_n}\otimes1)\mu_p$, the evaluated $g_X$ counit is the ordinary finite sections counit, and the evaluated $\gamma$ is the sheafified open chain map. Direct-image composition comparisons, scalar restriction and pullback-composition comparisons carry these specified words and their units and counits to the finite ones. These identities apply to the already constructed system morphism; they require no K-injectivity of evaluations on the varying-ring site and no lifting or uniqueness principle for compatible finite derived maps. For $Y=\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ the point-sections convention is [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point].

proof.text: Expand ScalarSpecialization.transported. Functoriality of coefficient evaluation moves its scalar-Hom tensor map before the untransported word equality. Naturality of e.integral.derived moves that tensor map through tensor evaluation. Compose the two resulting finite tensor maps by functoriality; identity on the support factor cancels, and the first factor becomes exactly e.homComparison. This proves PairingEquation for every K,N and the existential conclusion.
